summary_5_lines: PRO PHYSIQUE FITNESS CLUB is a gym in Sector 15-A/2, Buffer Zone, North Nazimabad Town, Karachi — 4.8 stars on Google with 244-305 reviews (range shown honestly) and phone +92 341 8119096, with no official website or social page found.

Chosen as Day 8 of the Pakistani demo lane (row 18 of the 28 Oct 2026 60-business no-website list): a top-rated North Nazimabad gym with no website, built on the verified snapshot because live re-verification on 11 Nov could not surface a fresh review page.

Design: bold brutalist type — near-black #15161A + signal yellow #FFD400 on off-white #F4F1EA, Bebas Neue + Open Sans, type-led hero ('TRAIN HARD. STAY STRONG.') with a full-width deadlift photo band below the type, numbered sections, yellow marquee and membership table.

Signature elements: numbered sections 01-08 with thick yellow rules, yellow marquee strip, membership table, lightbox gallery, map + hours card, FAQ accordion, click-to-call throughout (tel:+923418119096).

Not verified: opening hours, membership prices, ladies' timings, trial terms, trainer names/certifications, founding year, exact current review count (quoted as the 244-305 range), and no verified logo — clean text wordmark kept, nothing invented; no review quotes used.
